adoption_law: HOLD is the default. READY requires every required_evidence item proven at evaluation time. Config presence alone is never operational proof.

auth_plane.note: Current FastAPI auth + RBAC + tenant scope remains the single auth plane. A future IdP (including Keycloak) wires through api/security/oidc.py per-tenant and never replaces this plane.

deps_renovate.policy: No renovate.json is admitted while .github/dependabot.yml provides the equivalent weekly pip/npm/actions/docker update surface (radar verdict REJECT_DUPLICATE_FOR_NOW). If ever revisited: dashboard + draft-review only, never automerge, human/repo acceptance for security and high-risk upgrades, no GitHub Actions workflow may depend on it.

customer_identity_oidc.note: Provider-neutral. A future Keycloak (or Entra ID / Google / customer IdP) wires per-tenant through api/security/oidc.py. No live IdP URLs or secrets are stored in this repo.

runtime_falco.note: Lab-only readiness profile. Falco stays disabled and nonprivileged; pilot only on a proven Linux/container runtime-detection gap the current controls cannot satisfy.

secrets_openbao.note: 1Password/environment remains the sole production secrets authority per SECRETS_HANDLING_POLICY.md and OIDC_AND_SECRET_POLICY.md. OpenBao is an adoption/readiness candidate only; transit/sign/verify is future capability.
